summary.text: Jay Jordan is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 63, who assumed office on April 1, 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a lawyer in the Pee Dee region, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Jordan's professional experience includes working as a lawyer in the Pee Dee region; Ballotpedia says he is a member of the South Carolina Bar Association and has chaired the Florence County Election Commission and Voter Registration Board.
He assumed office on April 1, 2015, and Ballotpedia lists him on the House Ethics Committee and the House Judiciary Committee for the 2025-2026 session; he chaired the Ethics Committee in 2021-2022.
